rhs.description: A compact, bushy shrub growing to 1. 5m tall. The leaves emerge a brilliant red in spring, turning a pinkish colour and then a green-red in summer. In autumn, the leaves turn yellow, orange and deep red before falling

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.cultivation: 宜种植于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季如有需要应浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦枯。
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖

rhs_zh.description: 紧凑、丛生状灌木，高可达 1. 5 米。 春季新叶鲜红明亮，随后转为粉红色，夏季则呈绿红色。 秋季落叶前，叶片会变为黄色、橙色和深红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 春季叶色为火红或猩红色，夏季转为带绿色调的红色，主脉和叶柄仍保持红色；秋季再转为炽烈的红色。 叶片较小，5 裂，裂片不规则，略具皱感，先端钝，叶缘具锯齿，分裂约达叶基的一半，并常向侧方弯曲。 叶柄很短。 'Beni maiko' 形成紧凑灌木，高可达 10 英尺（3 米），以春季叶色尤为醒目，也适合容器栽培。 其名称意为“红发舞姬”。 'Beni o¯take' Group 为红叶组。 该品种姿态优美，生长健壮且直立，具有独特的竹状外观与树形。 深紫红色叶片在春季尤为出色，整个夏季都能较好保持红色，秋季转为鲜艳色彩。 叶片大，5 至 7 裂，裂片开展。 每个带状裂片都比多数 linearilobum 类型更宽，具细长尾状尖端，且大部分叶缘具锐尖锯齿。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Beni maiko' Bright Red 'Beni Maiko' Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Beni maiko' is a great Japanese maple for contrast throughout the seasons. It leafs out in the early spring with that cherry red display that will steal the show in your garden. At this point 'Beni maiko' is one of the brightest cherry reds of any Japanese maple. By early summer, the cherry red has faded to a green-red. In the autumn, 'Beni maiko' turns to a bright fire-engine red lighting up your landscape. 'Beni' translates as red while 'maiko' is an apprentice to a geisha girl in western Japan, giving credit to this Japanese maple's beauty.
